correctness.rationale: Replayed and independently re-derived all essential computations. Exponent matrix E=[[2,0,0],[0,0,0],[0,0,0]] follows from exponent sums (r1 has x^2; r2=[x,z] and r3=[[x,y],z] balanced), SNF diag(2,0,0) verified by script and inspection, giving H1=Z/2 x Z^2, H2=Z^2, H^1=Z Y+Z Z, H^2=Z/2 x Z^2, delta(s)=(2s1,0,0). Independently recomputed augmented second Fox derivatives via naive group-ring Fox rules (d(xi)/dxj, d(xi^-1)/dxj, Leibniz) and obtained exactly A1=[[1,0,0],[0,0,2],[0,-2,0]], A2=[[0,0,1],[0,0,0],[-1,0,0]], A3=0, matching committed matrices. Cup cochains YxY=(0,0,0), YxZ=(2,0,0), ZxY=(-2,0,0), ZxZ=(0,0,0) follow by C(u,v)_k=sum u_i v_j A^k_ij; bounds (1,0,0),(-1,0,0),0 are exact since delta(1,0,0)=(2,0,0). Hence all H^1xH^1 cups vanish in cohomology; H^1xH^2 and higher vanish for degree reasons (2-dimensional complex). Torus control [x,y] gives XY=+1/YX=-1 under same formula, validating sign convention; all-commutator control correctly non-zero. Massey <Y,Z,Z> defined (pairwise cups null); with s=(1,0,0),t=(0,0,0), m=sUZ-YUt=(0,1,0) because sUZ picks A2_13=1. Indeterminacy I=Y.H^1+H^1.Z+B^2 has generators (2,0,0) or (0,0,0) only, so middle-coordinate projection kills I and sends m to 1: exact quotient homomorphism C^2->Z descending to H^2/I, proving m not in I with infinite order. Bounding-choice variation s'=(1,a,b) changes m by (aY+bZ)UZ in H^1.Z and similarly for t, hence well-defined class; script robustness check confirmed. Full 8-triple table recomputed by hand and script: YZZ=(0,1,0) and ZZY=(0,-1,0) non-zero, other six zero. Rational vanishing/non-vanishing follows (cups vanish over Q; Q-span of I still has middle 0). Non-formality corollary uses standard Massey obstruction to formality (DGMS), correctly applied. No proof/experiment confusion: claims are computation-backed certificates, replayable via stdlib verify.py. Minor heuristic imprecision in sharpness remark (3 minimal for triple shape; repeats could in principle use fewer distinct classes) does not affect core witness and is explicitly left open (no 2-generator lemma claimed).

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp. Closest cup-trivial-but-Massey phenomenon is Limonchenko-Panov arXiv:2201.12779 (minimally non-Golod Z_K with trivial cup and non-trivial triple Massey) and Grbic-Linton arXiv:1911.07083 (infinitely many non-formal manifolds via moment-angle complexes): both live in moment-angle/polyhedral-product family in high dimensions with face-ring/Golod mechanisms, not 2-dimensional closed balanced deficiency-zero presentation complexes, and do not mechanically imply the committed witness or indeterminacy quotient. Poirier-Tradler-Wilson arXiv:2507.15494 gives general A-infinity Massey-inner-product framework with lens-space/link/low-manifold applications, no balanced presentation 2-complex witness. Lee et al arXiv:1909.06714 gives plane-curve Massey algorithm in disjoint algebro-geometric setting. Hatcher Ch.3 gives only torus-vs-wedge cup separator, explicitly absent here by design (rational rings coincide). Live arXiv API queries reproduced zero-hit gap: 'presentation complex'+Massey=0 hits, 'deficiency zero'+formality=0 hits, 'balanced presentation'+Massey=0 hits, '2-complex'+Massey=1 hit only (Krushkal-Teichner math/9705222 on gropes/A-B slice, different claim/route). Borromean/link-complement Massey examples carry boundary-torus/peripheral structure and non-zero deficiency, not closed balanced 2-complexes; spine conversion is not mechanical. No source records a closed balanced 3-generator 2-complex with identically vanishing integral cup and strictly defined non-zero triple Massey modulo full indeterminacy with matrices.

value.rationale: Independently worth retrieving: first closed balanced cup-trivial Massey-nonformal 2-complex witness, sharpening where Massey non-formality first appears among finite 2-complexes when cups vanish (recognized Sullivan/DGMS formality-vs-Massey program). Changes a known boundary (integral/rational rings do not determine rational homotopy type even cup-trivially) and supplies citable minimal benchmark for GAP/HAP, SageMath, cohomology-ring formalizations with replayable defining system plus complete 8-triple indeterminacy table. Not a textbook restatement (torus-vs-wedge mechanism absent), not mere parameter substitution (relators jointly satisfy non-trivial vanishing + non-membership constraints), not tiny unmotivated gain or unexplained enumeration (full table explained by projection proof).
